# P30.2a — Camera-registry predicates in the predicate registry (GO-LIVE.2a)

Implements `docs/tickets/P30.2a__camera-predicate-registry.md` (inserted 2026-09-24, operator: "Fix resolution
first, then launch"). Stacked on `devin/p30-2-hosted-round6-materialization` (`83cd666`). Decision: **ADR-104**.
Requirement ids: SIG-ONTO-066/067, SIG-RECON-008/009/012/013/014/020, SIG-EPIS-017/018, SIG-GEO-009, SIG-STORE-046.

## Summary

P30.2 measured **0 resolved sites of 230,267** on the hosted spine. Measuring first showed three causes, not one:
the 14 camera-registry predicates (2,050,954 claims) had no registry row; their evidence genres
(`camera_registry`, `connector_run`) were not on the directness axis (only **9 claims** in the whole spine were
admissible); and all camera claims have `observed_at` NULL, which every reader turned into 1970-01-01 —
HISTORICAL, so a 2026 registry row would have been published as "insufficient evidence". This PR fixes all three
in the ontology source and the §28 resolver, then re-materializes resolution in GCP.

## What changed

- **Ontology source** `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml` (→ `make gen`: generated registry, SKOS, vocab summary):
  +2 genres (every pre-existing predicate reads D6 there — behaviour-preserving), +14 predicates with volatility /
  half-life, strategy, full directness rows; coordinates carry `value_tolerance: {kind: absolute, value: 0.0005,
  unit: degree}`.
- **Resolver** (`reconcile/resolve.py`, `ruleset.py`): absolute tolerance pools agreeing numeric values into one
  candidate carrying an **observed** value (never a mean, §19.4); the absolute U4 takes the spread over every
  weighed member value (a second pool or a long chain → UNRESOLVED, kept visible); `Claim.observed_at_basis` +
  the labelled rule `SIG-RECON-008:observed_at=capture_retrieved_at`.
- **Readers** (`reconcile.materialize.read_claim_groups`, `reconcile resolve` CLI — now the same reader, three
  `api.store_pg` readers): undated claims dated from their earliest capture's UTC date (`CAPTURE_TIME_JOIN`,
  `observation_time`).
- **Write path**: vocab upserts once per distinct triple; envelopes batched one transaction per 1,000 rows;
  progress on stderr.
- **Eval report**: new `value_resolved_site_count` / `entity_merges` lines; generator reads
  `docs/build/reports/p30.2a-hosted/resolution_scale.json`.
- Tests, ADR-104, BL-057, Appendix F (+ rebuilt spec), ADR index, DEFERRALS (D-P30.2-3 advanced; D-P30.2a-1/-2
  opened), run ledger `docs/build/runs/P30.2a.md`.

| re-run | `sig-materialize-8lzql` (same image) — see run ledger (+0 expected; recorded there) |

| entity merges / dedup ratio | 0 / **not measured** |
| append-only | `n_tup_upd = n_tup_del = 0` on claim, resolution, contradiction; Cloud SQL tier unchanged |

**What these numbers mean:** §28 *value* resolution within each source's own camera record (every hosted camera
subject is one source's row; re-captures supersede). **What they do not mean:** deduplicated / resolved *sites*.
No cross-source merge exists (P30.2b). `exports.spine_export.resolved_sites_metric` would currently read N ≈ M
from value decisions — it must not be published as a dedup figure; P30.2b redefines it and P30.3 publishes
P30.2b's measured metric.

## Deviations

- **MET-DIFFERENTLY:** "spatial-tolerance strategy" is a per-predicate absolute tolerance (U4 "the predicate's
  tolerance"), not a new §28.4 strategy (closed set, SIG-RECON-012) — ADR-104 §3.
- Scope needed for a truthful result (ADR-104): the genre axis, capture-time dating, batched writes.
- First unbatched hosted attempts: one failed on a connector reset (0 rows), one cancelled after 85,541 rows
  (kept; idempotent) to switch to batched writes.
